test-release-package-dist: pin trace-reader TODOs 269 to 273 (#286)

Case 27 of tools/test-release-package-dist.py now holds the 5 gaps
that TODOs 269 to 273 record for the trace reader, each with a case
that fails without it. The packager and the reader are unchanged.

- fork() = 101 is read as the call, and its child starts in the
  folder of its maker.
- For each of clone, clone3, fork and vfork that strace cut short,
  with no result or with the result ?, 1 later process with no maker
  is read by its absolute paths, and a second ends the case.
- A call read with its arguments that ends as "= ? <unavailable>"
  counts as cut short with the result ?: an unlink counts as a
  removal, and a chdir leaves a shared folder unknown. That strace
  writes this form for such a call is not verified, and the comment
  and the module docstring say so. The refusal clause in 2 docstrings
  now names the form it covers, a call cut short by <unfinished ...>
  before the ) of its result.
- fchdir into a descriptor with no path, or with a relative path,
  ends the case.
- renameat2 gives both of its paths, each read against its own
  descriptor.

Checks: python3 -I tools/test-release-package-dist.py TraceReaderTests
gives 4 tests, OK, here and 3 tests, OK, on main. Each of the 8
reader mutants that the pull request description lists passes case
27 on main and fails it here. In a git checkout with strace, the full
run leaves cases 1 to 26 as they are on main.
